newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice closes higher as futures race to cash.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice closes higher as futures race to cash.

text.p: CBOT rice futures closed higher as the futures market raced to catch up with the premium the U.S.domestic cash market held over futures, traders said.
"Futures got undervalued to cash and cash interests took it (futures) up today," a trader said.
Traders said buy stops were hit in the March contract in late dealings at the $10.78 per cwt level.
Rice futures volume was estimated at 300 contracts, about the same as the 297 traded Wednesday.
Rice closed seven to 11-1/2 cents per cwt higher, with January up 11-1/2 at $10.72.
